title: Potato Gnocchi with Tomato Sauce
description: Soft potato gnocchi served with a simple tomato and basil sauce.

method.instruction: Cook potatoes in a pan of boiling water for 15–20 minutes until tender. Drain thoroughly and mash until smooth.
Transfer to a bowl and allow to cool slightly. Add flour, Parmesan, melted butter, salt, and pepper.
Using a flat-bladed knife, mix with a cutting motion to form a firm dough.
Knead briefly on a lightly floured surface until smooth. Do not over-handle or the gnocchi will be tough.
Roll heaped teaspoons of dough into oval shapes and indent one side with the back of a fork.
Cook gnocchi in batches in rapidly boiling salted water for 3–5 minutes. When they float, they are cooked.
Drain well and keep warm while cooking remaining gnocchi.
To make the tomato sauce, combine tomatoes, garlic, wine, basil, salt, and pepper in a pan.
Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer gently for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.
Serve gnocchi in warmed bowls with tomato sauce and extra grated Parmesan.

notes.title: Basil Tip
notes.content: Fresh basil should be added at the end of cooking to preserve its flavour. Chop or tear just before using to prevent blackening.
